name: orchestrate-team-invite-blocker
description: Resolve a worker blocker from canonical state and design evidence, then write a resume packet and update the orchestration state.
prompt: Use /orchestrate to process `.arcana/orchestrate/team-invite-approvals/packets/phase-01-foundation.blocker.md`. Read the existing orchestration state, design.md, and docs/adr/ADR-012-invite-seats.md. Do not ask follow-up questions. Resolve the blocker from the available evidence, write `.arcana/orchestrate/team-invite-approvals/packets/phase-01-foundation.resume.md`, and update `.arcana/orchestrate/team-invite-approvals/orchestrator.state.md` with the decision and blocker status. Leave the blocker file unchanged.

expected.description: Creates the matching resume file for the blocked packet.
Updates the orchestration state with the blocker decision.
Resume file answers the seat-consumption blocker from the documented evidence.
contentIncludesAny: do not consume a paid seat
Pending invites do not consume a paid seat
seat consumption begins only after the invite is approved

expected.description: Resume file tells the worker how to continue and where to return the result.

falsePositives.description: Does not rewrite the worker blocker report.
Resume file should not bounce the decision back to the user when the evidence is already clear.
